_comment: Reference: Weglot Reverse Proxy origin + per-locale cache behaviors. Applied via cloudfront-add-weglot-proxy.sh; do NOT paste this JSON directly into aws cloudfront update-distribution.
_routing_model: Option 1 — public-only. Authenticated + PII-sensitive routes stay on ALB. See cloudfront-weglot-proxy.md for the full rationale.

alb_first._note: CachingDisabled + AllViewer origin request policy — same shape as the existing /api/* and /share/* behaviors so Clerk session cookies + query strings pass unchanged.

weglot_catchall._note: CachingDisabled during rollout; swap to CachingOptimized once Weglot cache invalidation behavior is confirmed.

_ordering_note: For each locale, ALB-first behaviors MUST precede the Weglot catchall in the CacheBehaviors.Items array. CloudFront picks the first matching PathPattern in array order.
_notes: Origin request policy: AllViewer (b689b0a8-53d0-40ab-baf2-68738e2966ac) forwards viewer cookies including Clerk session tokens. The proxy passes them straight to our ALB origin so /{locale}/dashboard etc. auth flows work.
The Weglot dashboard 'External Provider' mode is required — if left on 'Weglot managed hosting', Weglot expects apex DNS control and the CloudFront path routing won't reach their proxy.
If translations return English on /de/edit, check the X-Weglot-Key header value in the CloudFront origin config matches the NEXT_PUBLIC_WEGLOT_API_KEY exactly (case-sensitive).
AWS CloudFront's default quota is 25 cache behaviors per distribution; this config lands at ~46 total. Request quota increase to 100 before applying (see runbook).
